vocabulary.definitionEn: to make something less severe, serious, or painful
vocabulary.topicIdeaVi: Sử dụng cho Writing Task 2 khi đề xuất biện pháp giảm nhẹ tác hại của biến đổi khí hậu.
vocabulary.exampleSentence: Effective governmental policies can significantly mitigate environmental damage in urban zones.

paragraphs.label: A
paragraphs.text: Municipal leaders across industrialized capitals are establishing modern eco-districts to mitigate environmental damage caused by vehicular emissions. These specialized urban developments deploy dense vegetative buffers along major freeways to capture airborne particulates and moderate localized temperatures effectively.

paragraphs.label: B
paragraphs.text: Nevertheless, civic planners acknowledge that green infrastructure alone cannot offset unchecked fossil fuel combustion. Transitioning public transit systems toward clean electric vehicles remains essential to achieve comprehensive atmospheric recovery.

questions.prompt: What is the primary function of vegetative buffers established along freeways in paragraph A?
options: To capture airborne particulates and moderate localized temperatures
To expand vehicle lanes for commuter traffic
To eliminate all municipal funding deficits
To prevent pedestrians from walking near roadways
questions.correctAnswer: To capture airborne particulates and moderate localized temperatures

evidence.text: capture airborne particulates and moderate localized temperatures

questions.explanation: Đoạn A nêu rõ các vùng đệm thực vật được bố trí để hấp thụ bụi mịn và điều hòa nhiệt độ.
